summary: Support an explicit per-invocation SQLite cache path for isolated automation and verifier runs.
reason: The AnyList CLI stores its synchronized protobuf projection in SQLite, but the generic data-pipeline verifier needs to place that cache in a temporary database. A real --db option also lets agents and tests isolate cache state without changing credentials or HOME.
validated_outcome: Added a non-persisted --db override, wired sync and SQL to the selected cache, accepted full-sync/resource-hint flags used by automation, and added explicit-path coverage. Full Go tests pass; the remaining mock-pipeline failure is caused by the verifier supplying JSON to AnyList's protobuf-only user-data endpoint, not by cache-path handling.
